verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own marketing copy says users can manage 'pipelines' (plural) alongside deals, which suggests more than one pipeline is supported. Nothing in the pack shows that each pipeline can have its own stage set, or that pipelines can be split by product or sales motion. missing for 10: documentation of multiple pipeline creation, per-pipeline custom stages, pipeline-per-product/motion configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions

citations.quote: Manage contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, activities, and conversations in one place.
